fields.summary_ko.0: On Monday, the second business day after Anthropic's (ANT) IPO, the stock declined 1.4% to trade at $88, up approximately 5% from the IPO price of $83.
fields.summary_ko.1: Concerns about fully diluted IPO valuation of approximately $1.5T (40x trailing revenue) and massive capital consumption needs of $900B over the next 20 years including $70B annually are key risk factors.
